classification: SIMULATED timing; no real latency or rendered-frame claim

build.source_commit_meaning: Git HEAD at build time; source_fingerprint binds actual source bytes, including uncommitted changes. Later report-only commits may differ.
build.deterministic_identity: No timestamps, absolute paths or Git metadata enter build_id; identical source and emitted bundle bytes produce the same identity.

workload.lifecycleMeaning: 20 result close/reopen cycles plus 20 hidden complete view/controller mount/dispose cycles on the unchanged host map.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HappyDOM/20.14.5

timing.endpoints: Before normal selection plus host cursor action to two animation-frame opportunities after awaited host seek and coordinated DOM update

selectionOnly.endpoints: Before normal selection to two animation-frame opportunities after chart, map callout and evidence DOM update; host cursor fixed

selectionAndCursor.endpoints: Before normal selection plus host cursor action to two animation-frame opportunities after awaited host seek and coordinated DOM update

productionReceiptUnmodified.performanceInterpretation: The dual-track sprint requires selection <=50 ms and combined selection plus host-year <=100 ms. Endpoints and 200 samples per phase are unchanged from M1; either miss remains an aggregate FAIL.

preparedExecutions.path: first prepared execution including local dataset load
